q: Can the consultant who prepared our carbon inventory also verify it?
title: Who cannot verify your inventory
short: No. A verifier must be independent of the work they check, so the firm or person who prepared or advised on your inventory should not verify it. ISO 14064-3 and accreditation rules require impartiality. Use a separate accredited body, and expect them to ask about any past consulting.

ul: The same firm built the inventory or chose the factors.
The verifier sells you software or credits linked to the result.
Fees that depend on the outcome.

p: A verifier can explain requirements and point out findings. Designing your system or writing your figures crosses the line.
Request the verifier's accreditation and a written statement of independence.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
